title: WorkspaceRequest

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine: an absolute path, or one starting ~ for the environment's home.

oneOf.description: A directory the environment has: recorded at its absolute path, ~ expanded to the environment's home.

repository.description: Any path inside the repository; the worktree is made from its main checkout.

branch.description: An existing local branch to check out in the worktree.

name.description: The new branch's name; agent-harness/ and the session id's first eight characters when absent.

base.description: The ref the branch starts from, any ref; the main checkout's HEAD when absent.

newBranch.description: A branch the worktree is made on, made with it.

oneOf.description: A worktree the environment makes from a repository it has: on an existing branch, or on a new one (the new branch with its presets when neither is named).
A scratch directory of the session's own.

sessionId.description: The session on this environment whose workspace to share.

oneOf.description: Another session's recorded workspace on this environment, shared: its kind, path and repository identity.

description: Where a new session's code is to live: a directory, a new worktree, a scratch directory, or another session's workspace.
